purpose: Phase-A collection run for the registered learned-perception study (config/learn/learned_perception_v1.json). Dataset generation only.
aux_view_model: approximation for training only: absolute (yaw,pitch,insertion) uniform in the registered ECM envelope; delta applied to the live camera frame about the ECM RCM point; never control input

episodes.reason: cut length 10.0 mm reached; scissors retracted

perception_cfg.basis: M4 shadow perception (scripts/vision/cut_perception.py): 'off' logs nothing, 'shadow' runs the estimator on the already-acquired image/depth each observe() and logs estimate + truth + errors into the report. It is never used for control unless cut.control_source is 'vision'. 'markers' stages two cyan/yellow spheres on the cutter yaw housing (non-respondable); kept on in both modes so the off-vs-shadow comparison isolates the estimator. depth_noise_m/camera_pose_error perturb ONLY the estimator inputs (seeded per run). camera_pose_error.mode: 'per_tick' draws a fresh error each tick (M5a semantics); 'fixed' draws the rotation axis and translation direction once per run (a calibration bias, config/task/m5b_protocol.json).
